remarks:
A masterpiece of quality, design and location! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac and set on an impressive .76-acre lot backing to wooded green space, this stunning 3 bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers exceptional comfort and privacy. From the covered front porch to the impressive two-story foyer, you’ll appreciate the thoughtful details and welcoming atmosphere throughout. Just off the foyer, the formal living and dining rooms feature recessed lighting, gas fireplace and beautiful front-to-back windows accented w/transom glass, filling the home with abundant natural light. 9-foot ceilings enhance the spacious feel of the first floor. The well-appointed kitchen boasts abundant maple cabinetry, granite countertops, pantry, ceramic tile flooring, glass tile backsplash and Blanco sink. All appliances are included. The adjoining eating area is surrounded by windows while enjoying views of the expansive backyard. Step through the French doors to a 2-tiered stamped concrete patio, ideal for outdoor entertaining or relaxing in the peaceful surroundings. The year-round Florida room offers additional living space w/luxury vinyl flooring and sliding doors that provide easy access to the patio and backyard. Convenience meets functionality with a first-floor laundry room featuring ceramic tile flooring and included washer and dryer, plus a beautiful half bath. Upstairs, all bedrooms feature laminate flooring. The spacious primary suite offers a tray ceiling, impressive 19' x 7' walk-in closet and an additional unfinished bonus area. The private primary bath features ceramic tile flooring, whirlpool tub, separate shower and dual-sink vanity. Another bedroom stands out with a cathedral ceiling, oversized arched window and wall of closets. The attached finished garage offers additional storage space, along w/water and electric. The basement features 8.5-ft ceilings and glass block windows, providing excellent potential for future use. Additional features include central air, 150-amp electrical service, tankless water heater, and a sump pump w/water backup. Updates: Stockade fence '24. Tankless water heater '21. Granite '20. Patio '17. Sq ft adjusted per floor plan.
O/D 10/23 by noon
